explanation: In a one-to-many relationship, one row on the parent side can relate to many rows on the child side. Here, a department can have many employees, and each employee is linked to one department.

options.text: Each employee can belong to many departments, and each department can belong to many employees
One department can be associated with many employees, while each employee belongs to one department
Each department must be split into multiple tables because it has many employees
The employee table should store one row for every department

prompt: A company keeps one record for each department and many records for the employees in that department. Which description best matches this relationship?
